WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    mt.Name,
    AVG(t.UnitPrice) as col2,
    AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) as col3
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804
  GROUP BY mt.Name
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(col3) as col1
  FROM step1
)
SELECT 
  step1.Name,
  step1.col2,
  step1.col3,
  step1.col3 / step2.col1 as col4
FROM step1, step2
WHERE step2.col1 IS NOT NULL
